oliver_ml: Starting onboarding for Theta-mini-8k (int4). Quick smoke shows summarization ROUGE-L drop ~4%. Suspect projector order + rotary scaling.

 tasha_conv: Which convert flags?

 oliver_ml: `convert.py --src theta_ckpt --out theta_rw --quant int4 --proj-layout qkv --rotary-scale auto --vocab-map maps/theta.json`

 sam_ops: Try `--proj-layout qkv_alt` and `--rotary-scale 1.0`. We've seen auto pick headwise signs that flip phases.

 rotary-bot: auto-check: head correlation negative on heads [2,7], magnitude -0.88. Possible sign inversion.

 tasha_conv: Also check vocab-map for collisions; rare-token coalescing caused duplicate token ids before. Run `vmap_diff.py maps/theta.json tokenizer.json`.

 oliver_ml: Ran quick reconv with qkv_alt + rotary=1.0 -> ROUGE-L improved from 42.1 to 46.3 (baseline float32 46.8). Long-chat still shows a couple duplicates at ~4k tokens; tracing shows mapping collision `src 90123 -> tgt 50123` and `src 90234 -> tgt 50123`.

 sam_ops: Regen mapping with deterministic tie-break (prefer lower src_id) and re-run. Add mapping_report output.

 qa-bot: Tagging thread `onboard/theta-mini`. Attach eval CSV and mapping_report when done.
